videos.title: Teen Wolf
videos.overview: After Scott and his rock band perform a song on a televised talent show, Scott is discovered by a record label that wants to sign him.

videos.title: Teen Wolf
videos.overview: Scott visits his cousin, Todd, but the two have nothing in common. As Scott tries to help Todd come out of his shell, he realizes that he and his cousin are much more alike than he initially thought.

videos.title: Teen Wolf
videos.overview: Scott's family album of werewolves gets mixed up in the back of Mick's car. He and his friend Stiles hunt it down in order to protect the Howard family secret.

videos.title: Archie's Weird Mysteries: The Day the Earth Moved
videos.overview: Giant, toothy-mawed worms the size of freight trains are plowing beneath the grounds of an old section of Riverdale, eating cars, buildings and anything they can detect moving on the surface.

videos.title: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Dance of the Killer Bees
videos.overview: Humanoid bee creatures begin causing trouble for the people of Riverdale after their leader, the Queen Bee, decides to make the attic of Riverdale High her new hive.

videos.title: THE NEW PINK PANTHER SHOW
videos.overview: 'Lights, Camera, Voodoo': Security guard Panther comes up against an egotistical star, a demented director and an obsessive fan at a movie studio. 'I'm Dreaming of a Pink Christmas': Pinky tries to instill the spirit of Christmas in a 'scrooge.'

videos.title: THE NEW PINK PANTHER SHOW
videos.overview: 'Wiener Takes All': The Panther runs a successful hot dog business until the competition kidnaps the founding granny. 'The Easter Panther': When the Panther is hired to handle the White House Easter Egg Hunt, he must foil a heist by the Dogfather.

videos.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
videos.overview: Robotnik's next stop in his time-travel is the time of King Arfur and the Knights of the Round Table to get the Emerald of Invincibility. Sonic follows him, but Robotnik, with the unwilling help of local wizard Merlynx, obtains the Emerald.

videos.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
videos.overview: In his next time-travel stop, Robotnik is erasing Sonic's family tree in order to get the Chaos Emerald of Immortality. Sonic goes after him, prevent Robotnik from interfering with his ancestors.

videos.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
videos.overview: Despite the intervention of Sonic and Tails, Robotnik obtains the Chaos Emerald of life in prehistory and the other emeralds and becomes the Supreme High Robotnik.

videos.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
videos.overview: Sonic and Tails babysit a trio of unruly baby beavers who end up being abducted by Scratch and Grounder. Robotnik uses the beavers as bait to capture Sonic and Tails, but the beavers become resourceful and help their friends thwart Robotnik.

videos.title: Inspector Gadget
videos.overview: The beautiful M.A.D. agent Labella is disrupting the peaceful country of Pianostan. Inspector Gadget stops her before she causes a revolution.

videos.title: Inspector Gadget
videos.overview: Dr. Claw is kidnapping billionaires and stealing their money. Inspector Gadget rescues the captured billionaires and protects their money.

videos.title: Mr Bean Animated
videos.overview: During a visit to Buckingham Palace, Mr. Bean meets the lady of the house. When Mr. Bean breaks his favourite Royal mug he discovers there's only one place to buy a replacement: Buckingham Palace, home of the Queen of England

videos.title: Mr Bean Animated
videos.overview: Mr. Bean takes a trip down Memory Lane. When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride?

videos.title: Mr Bean Animated
videos.overview: Mr. Bean, badgered by a strange pink animal, warms to the creature when it shows its true colours. Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms.

videos.title: Mr Bean Animated
videos.overview: When invited to dinner by Mr. Bean, it’s probably best to take your own sandwiches. Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven.

videos.title: Mr Bean Animated
videos.overview: Mr. Bean makes it to the top of the ladder… and gets stuck. The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road.

videos.title: Ripley's Believe It or Not!
videos.overview: The BION team travel to London to bid on the Winged Warrior Helmet, said to give the wearer the strength of ten.

videos.title: Ripley's Believe It or Not!
videos.overview: Rip finds in his uncle's diary details of a failed trip to Tibet, searching evidence of the Yeti.

videos.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths & Legends
videos.overview: Logan encounters a group of aliens and doesn't pull any punches trying to find out what happened to his real father...

videos.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths & Legends
videos.overview: The Alliance attacks the alien safehouse in order to stop the renegade Logan...

videos.title: H2O: Just Add Water
videos.overview: Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.

videos.title: H2O: Just Add Water
videos.overview: The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!

videos.title: H2O: Just Add Water
videos.overview: Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!

videos.title: H2O: Just Add Water
videos.overview: Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.

videos.title: H2O: Just Add Water
videos.overview: Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.

videos.title: H2O: Just Add Water
videos.overview: Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. He works out she’s still a mermaid and tries to win her back. Cleo becomes suspicious of Lewis spending time with Charlotte.

videos.title: Beyblade Shogun Steel
videos.overview: Yoshio defeats Akuya and his followers, but then loses to Zyro. Kira appears and battles and defeats Shinobu.

videos.title: Beyblade Shogun Steel
videos.overview: Zyro battles Kira in a Synchrome bey match, and his Salamader Ifrit loses to Kira's Golem Behemoth.

videos.title: Beyblade Shogun Steel
videos.overview: The Neo Battle Bladers tournament begins, and the qualifying round is filled with interesting battles.

videos.title: Beyblade Shogun Steel
videos.overview: The preliminary round of the Neo Battle Bladers tournament comes to an end and the eight Bladers who will go to the finals are named.

videos.title: Beyblade Shogun Steel
videos.overview: In the next round of the Neo Battle Bladers tournament, the four semi—finalists are determined.

videos.title: Beyblade Shogun Steel
videos.overview: Zyro defeats Sakyo to advance to the finals of the Neo Battle Bladers Tournament.

videos.title: Sabrina The Animated
videos.overview: The Student of the Year winner will be announced soon and Sabrina and Gem are tied to win. Gem uses her money to win the contest so Sabrina uses magic to make Gem lose.

videos.title: Sabrina The Animated
videos.overview: Sabrina, desperate to earn money for an upcoming concert, baby sits the terror twins. Hilda, Zelda and Uncle Quigley warn her that she's just not ready but Sabrina is adamant.

videos.title: Sabrina The Animated
videos.overview: Harvey mistakenly thanks Sabrina for saving his life. She feels bad for the unearned praise she is getting. Sabrina, with Salem's help travels back in time to redo everything.

videos.title: Sabrina The Animated
videos.overview: Determined to make Harvey happy, Sabrina dabbles in the spooky jar to make him the raddest skateboarder since Tony Hawk, so he can join a pro team.
